description: Converge the CLI install/update command surface to the verb-root (mo install / mo update): delete the redundant mo server install, mo server update, and mo runner install subcommands, preserve the mo runner update non-existence invariant, keep all non-install/update resource subcommands and the verb-root entries untouched, and sync docs/cli-reference.md.

tasks.title: Remove redundant install/update resource-subcommands, guard the surface, and sync CLI reference docs
tasks.description: In packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliCommands.Server.cs, delete ServerCommands.BuildInstall and ServerCommands.BuildUpdate (private methods + their two Subcommands.Add registrations in ServerCommands.Build) and the now-orphaned `updater` local (keep `installer`, still used by systemd/logs); delete RunnerCommands.BuildInstall and its runner.Subcommands.Add registration. Leave InstallCommands (MohistCliCommands.Install.cs) and UpdateCommands (MohistCliCommands.Update.cs) untouched so mo install server/runner and mo update[/cli/server/runner] keep hitting the same IServiceInstaller / SourceCodeUpdater methods with the same flags. Add regression guards reusing issue-387's Legacy* pattern in CliRootCommandShapeSpecs.cs / CliRunnerCommandSpecs.cs (parse-failure + no-side-effect for the 3 deleted paths and for mo runner update), flip the existing mo runner --help `Contains("install")` assertion to DoesNotContain, and assert verb-root behavior unchanged. Finally sync docs/cli-reference.md (drop the gap-table row, the Runner-section mo runner install line, the Server-section mo server install/update lines, and the command-path migration note) and extend CliReferenceDocsSpecs forbidden-legacy-row guard to forbid those legacy strings.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo server install` fails to resolve, exits non-zero, and does NOT invoke IServiceInstaller.InstallServerAsync or any installer method (verified via FakeServiceInstaller recording no calls).
`mo server update` fails to resolve, exits non-zero, and does NOT invoke SourceCodeUpdater.UpdateServerAsync or any updater method.
`mo runner install` fails to resolve, exits non-zero, and does NOT invoke IServiceInstaller.InstallRunnerAsync or any installer method.

`mo runner update` fails to resolve, exits non-zero, and does NOT invoke any SourceCodeUpdater method (the pre-existing non-existence invariant is preserved and pinned by an explicit regression guard).

`mo install server` / `mo install runner` still resolve under the install verb-root and invoke IServiceInstaller.InstallServerAsync / InstallRunnerAsync with a ServiceInstallOptions carrying the same flag values (--repo-root, --listen-url on server, --server-url / --runner-root on runner, plus shared --dry-run / --unit-dir), defaults, and exit semantics as before this change.

`mo update`, `mo update cli`, `mo update server`, and `mo update runner` still resolve under the update verb-root and invoke SourceCodeUpdater.UpdateAllAsync / UpdateCliAsync / UpdateServerAsync / UpdateRunnerAsync respectively with the same arguments, flags (--repo-root, --dry-run, --cli-path, internal --continue-after-cli-update), and stage-machine ordering as before this change.
`mo server --help` advertises start, stop, restart, status, logs, health, uninstall, info and does NOT advertise install or update.
`mo runner --help` advertises start, stop, restart, service-status, logs, uninstall, list, show, status and does NOT advertise install or update.

Surviving `mo server <subcommand>` and `mo runner <subcommand>` (e.g. mo server status, mo server restart, mo runner list, mo runner status) still resolve and dispatch to the same handlers with the same options and defaults as before this change.
CliRunnerCommandSpecs.RunnerHelp_ListsListSubcommand's `install` assertion is flipped from Assert.Contains to Assert.DoesNotContain (no red test left behind).

docs/cli-reference.md: the Runner command-group code block no longer lists `mo runner install`; the Server command-group code block no longer lists `mo server install` or `mo server update`; the implementation-gap table no longer contains the row tracking the mo server install/update / mo runner install/update double-entry convergence; the command-path migration note referencing that convergence is removed; the 「安装与升级（动词根集中）」 section remains the canonical statement of the install/update surface and is unchanged.

CliReferenceDocsSpecs forbidden-legacy-row guard is extended so the docs spec fails if `mo server install`, `mo server update`, `mo runner install`, or the command-path migration note reappear in docs/cli-reference.md.
packages/cli builds under TreatWarningsAsErrors (no orphaned `installer`/`updater` locals, no dangling references to the deleted private BuildInstall/BuildUpdate methods).

`npm test -w packages/cli` is fully green; all new/changed tests comply with design/testing.md (no real network/process/git/systemd/DB, no wall clock — installer via FakeServiceInstaller, updater via fakes).
tasks.output: Edited packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliCommands.Server.cs (3 deletions + orphaned `updater` var removed), edited/extended packages/cli/tests/Mohist.Cli.Tests/{CliRunnerCommandSpecs.cs,CliRootCommandShapeSpecs.cs,CliReferenceDocsSpecs.cs}, edited docs/cli-reference.md; green `npm test -w packages/cli` (incl. TreatWarningsAsErrors).
tasks.notes: Design D2 dead-code boundary: in ServerCommands.Build keep `installer` (used by BuildSystemd start/stop/restart/status/uninstall and BuildLogs) and delete `updater` (only consumer was BuildUpdate); RunnerCommands.Build has no `updater` local, only delete its BuildInstall + registration. Design D4 test strategy: reuse issue-387's CliRootCommandShapeSpecs Legacy* shape (call MohistCliCommands.RunAsync on the deleted path, assert exitCode != 0 and handler/fake recorded no requests). InstallCommands (MohistCliCommands.Install.cs) and UpdateCommands (MohistCliCommands.Update.cs) must NOT be edited — they are the retained verb-root entries. No server-side changes, no schema migration, no IServiceInstaller / SourceCodeUpdater signature changes. Breaking change: 3 command paths removed — release/changelog should point users at the verb-root mo install <component> / mo update <component>.
